newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks close flat on election worries.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks close flat on election worries.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed almost unchanged in dull trading on Wednesday as investors remained cautious ahead of Friday's local government elections, brokers said.
The Colombo all share index closed 0.3 points down at 633 while turnover fell to 20.3 million rupees from 86.3 million rupees on Tuesday.
"Caution is what is keeping activity down. Investors are concerned about election-related violence and resulting loss of production," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
"But the market fundamentals have not changed and we think it will pick up again next week after the election," he said.

"Aitken Spence picked up on news that tourist arrivals for this year looks good," said Thikshan Arulampalam, a trader at Lanka Securities. "The news has made people go for Spence as their exposure to tourism is high."
Shares of Aitken Spence rose two to 112. But overall, losses outnumbered gains 23 to 15.
